[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] Claude Mythos Preview demonstrated near-perfect accuracy and bias scores on questions where there is not enough information to correctly answer the question.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] On disambiguated questions where there is enough information to identify a correct answer, Claude Mythos Preview showed some regression in performance compared to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6. 8.3 Agentic safety appendix 8.3.1 Malicious use of agents Prior to releasing Claude Mythos Preview, we ran a similar suite of agentic safety evaluations as were conducted for the release of our most recent models, Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.6, along with a new evaluation focusing on model capabilities to autonomously execute influence operations campaigns.
